annotations.title: What to buy for a room (quick)

description: Works out how much paint, wallpaper, wall tiles, flooring, carpet, skirting, loft insulation, plasterboard, concrete or patio paving one room needs, and everything else to buy for the job (preparation, tools, safety), in real UK pack sizes. Takes the job and either the room's length, width and height, or a typical room by name for a room that has not been measured; the answer then states that the measurements are typical. Returns a short shopping list and a link to the whole list. It does not take exact door sizes, a product's own coverage or pack size, tiling part-way up a wall or an L-shaped room.

doors.description: How many doors. Each is taken off the wall area at a typical size.

height.description: Floor to ceiling, in the units. Needed for paint, wallpaper and wall tiles. 2.4 m is a typical UK ceiling height.

job.description: The job. Required. wallpaper is the paint job with papered walls and no ceiling; tiles is the paint job with tiled walls and no ceiling; both is paint and a new floor; paint-carpet is paint and one unjoined piece of carpet; skirting is skirting and architrave.

length.description: The room's length, in the units.

room.description: A typical room, for a person who has not measured: bedroom-small (3 m × 2.5 m), bedroom-large (4 m × 3.5 m), living-small (4 m × 3 m), living-large (5.5 m × 4 m), kitchen-small (3 m × 2 m), kitchen-large (4.5 m × 3.5 m), bathroom-small (2 m × 1.7 m), bathroom-large (2.7 m × 2.4 m), each 2.4 m high. The answer states that these are typical measurements. Not used together with length and width.

units.description: What the measurements are in. Metres if left out.

width.description: The room's width, in the units.

windows.description: How many windows. Each is taken off the wall area at a typical size.
